device: M5 Max (h17c), one shared host, load average 7.6-13 during the runs
method: Scratch probe against Core AI alone (not committed), release build, run under the shared GPU lock. Each bucketed asset's main function is loaded with SpecializationOptions(preferredComputeUnitKind: .gpu) and expectFrequentReshapes = true, then 230 one-token steps are encoded and joined on one ComputeStream (30 warm-up, 200 measured, medians and 90th percentiles in microseconds). Inputs mirror LanguageGenerationSession.step: token and cache position [1, 1], zero-copy zeroed key/value caches at the stated capacity (zeroed caches change no shape or cost). 'convert' is LanguageGenerationSession.step's own conversion of the logits NDArray into a new [Float], verbatim, in a non-inlined function. 'outputView' runs the same step with a Kit-owned shared MTLBuffer passed as the logits output view, then scans it in place; its argmax equalled the NDArray path's on every step. Host costs were measured on one real logits row from each model (the first step's), 300 runs after 20 warm-up runs, single thread.

host.row: qwen3-4b-instruct-2507-abliterated first-step logits (the 0.6B row gave the same costs within 10%)
host.note: Inside the probe's native loop the same scalar argmax took about 145 us (no finiteness check); the scalar numbers here are an upper bound for straightforward Swift loops, not tuned code.
